components.purpose: Covers the 'Why teams choose us' section heading with its short subheading, placed directly above the feature cards. This component (id 25, 'A generic header section that can have just a heading, but also a subheading and description') has a Subheading field (eyebrow/short text) and a Heading field (main headline) — Subheading would hold the short supporting line and Heading would hold 'Why teams choose us'.
The existing/pre-existing feature cards section ('Grid of items') that the new heading sits above — included here only for placement context, not something new to add.
